title: The timeline
caption: Four disciplines on one language model, from prompting in 2022–23 to the factory emerging in 2026.

readme.heading: Read me
readme.shows: The scale each discipline compares to, the four cards on the rail, a scene per discipline, its wire down to the model, and the model band. At rest nothing moves.
readme.tryit: Move the mouse onto a column to play its scene. Click a card or the model band to turn it to its definition and source. Press "Play all" to play the four in turn.
readme.notice: Every message to the model is a square down the wire and back: one for a prompt, three loops for an agent, three side by side at a workflow's fan-out, up to five at once for the factory.

timeline.header: Where the years and definitions come from
timeline.description: Every year, definition and source on the cards comes from research LLM-0018, which dates each discipline by its primary source: ChatGPT's launch for prompting, Anthropic's agent definition and Claude Code for agents, LangGraph for workflows, and Dan Shapiro's five levels and StrongDM for the factory.
